1. Postman silently auto-installs AI plugins and attempts to share all API data

Source: HackerNews | Topic: hn | Coverage: 1 source | Discussion

Summary

Postman users have reported that the application is silently installing AI-powered plugins and attempting to sync sensitive API data to cloud services. This has raised significant privacy and security concerns regarding data handling and consent. Postman has not yet provided a comprehensive fix or explanation for the behavior.

My Take

Nothing says 'we value your privacy' like secretly installing a digital vacuum cleaner that tries to inhale your entire API infrastructure. It’s the tech equivalent of a stranger breaking into your house to 'organize' your files, only to mail them to a server in the desert. Source: HackerNews | Topic: hn | Coverage: 1 source | Discussion

Summary

Users have discovered that encrypted firmware on Nvidia RTX Spark GPUs causes inference speeds to drop to 35% when running on Linux. My Take
